svg.aria-label: GRC Made Simple Daily newsletter. Hey Control Freaks! That's how every edition of GRC Made Simple Daily starts. Everything that happened in GRC, AI governance, AI security, privacy and post-quantum today, in one place. 23 editions published, new every weekday. Latest: 2026-11-19 EU sanctions pro-Russian DDoS group NoName057(16), in force 16 Nov; 2026-11-18 Everyone Is Scanning. Nobody Is Asking, Guest Edition: Vikram Das; 2026-11-17 Your incident plan breaks at the hand-off. Rehearse it in forty-five minutes. Subscribe on LinkedIn.
